title: USP Paid Bookings Extension
description: Extends dev.ucp.shopping.checkout with booking context. UCP assimilation artifact for integrating USP scheduling with UCP checkout. When complete_checkout succeeds, payment and booking are atomically finalized.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Extension properties added to UCP checkout schema for USP paid bookings.

booking.description: USP booking context embedded in the checkout. Created when checkout is created; confirmed when complete_checkout succeeds.

BookingContext.title: BookingContext
BookingContext.description: Booking context for UCP checkout. Contains scheduling details that are validated at create_checkout and finalized at complete_checkout.

booking_id.description: Unique booking identifier. Generated by the business when the checkout is created (response only).

hold_id.description: The hold ID if a slot was held.

booking_status.description: pending while checkout is incomplete; confirmed when complete_checkout succeeds (response only).

recipient.description: The person receiving the service, when different from the buyer. Same schema as Buyer. When absent, the buyer is the recipient.

SlotReference.title: SlotReference
SlotReference.description: Reference to a booked time slot.
